law_name: Personal Data Protection and Habeas Data Act (Law No. 18.331)
jurisdiction: Regulatory and Control Unit for Personal Data (URCDP)
key_requirements: Prior informed consent, purpose limitation, data subject rights, database registration
retention_period: As long as necessary for the purpose
enforcement_authority: Regulatory and Control Unit for Personal Data (URCDP) within AGESIC
exemptions: Personal/domestic use; public security, defence & State security
notes: Regulated by Decree 414/009; territorial scope extended by Law 19.670 (arts 37-40)
